nodes.label: Eloquent API Resource and Controller Sample
nodes.norm_label: eloquent api resource and controller sample
nodes.rationale: API Resources are requested specifically to guarantee clean JSON output decoupled from the model.

nodes.label: API Route Blueprint
nodes.rationale: A structured endpoint list in routes/api.php following strict RESTful naming conventions, mirroring the portal's core modules.

nodes.label: Sanctum Authentication Strategy
nodes.rationale: Step-by-step token authentication with Laravel Sanctum, explicitly ensuring Sanctum guards do not conflict with Filament's session guards.

nodes.label: Hostinger Hosting Target
nodes.rationale: Shared Hostinger hosting constrains deployment steps and rules out infrastructure-heavy auth designs.

nodes.label: Academic Core
nodes.rationale: Course modules, unlocked lesson progressions, grading, and attendance tracking form the academic domain.

nodes.label: 2026 Course Catalog Pricing
nodes.rationale: Catalog and seeder updated together so seeded environments reflect the same Certificate/Diploma/Advanced Diploma prices as production.

nodes.label: Auth Endpoints (/auth)
nodes.rationale: Login, Logout, Token Refresh, and Profile (/me).

nodes.label: Grades Endpoints (/grades)
nodes.rationale: Exposes assessment scores plus server-side GPA summary calculation so the client does not reimplement grading math.

nodes.label: Payments Endpoints (/payments)
nodes.rationale: History, outstanding balances, and signed PDF receipt downloads; receipts are signed URLs so they can be fetched by a stateless client without exposing an open document endpoint.

nodes.label: Student Profile Endpoints (/student)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately limited profile editing plus avatar upload and document links, so the mobile app cannot mutate registrar-controlled fields.

nodes.label: Financials and Fee Workflows
nodes.rationale: Integrated fee workflows, invoice generation, and live payments via Paystack and TGIPay.

nodes.label: Laravel Sanctum Bearer Token Auth
nodes.rationale: Sanctum bearer tokens protect the API; its migrations ship with the standard migrate run.

nodes.label: Stateless Mobile API v1
nodes.rationale: A fully stateless, token-based v1 RESTful API in routes/api.php for a companion mobile app; responses are standardized JSON wrapped in API Resources so the mobile client sees a stable contract independent of Eloquent model shape.

nodes.label: Student Management
nodes.rationale: Full lifecycle management from admission to graduation.

nodes.label: API Integration Blueprint Brief
nodes.rationale: An architect-persona prompt asking for a structured blueprint to layer a clean, secure REST API over the existing live Laravel + Filament portal for a mobile counterpart app.

nodes.label: Robots Crawler Policy (Allow All)
nodes.rationale: User-agent: * with an empty Disallow permits all crawlers on every path — the Laravel default, left unrestricted even though the portal serves authenticated student data, since that data sits behind auth rather than behind robots rules.

nodes.label: Tenstrings Portal
nodes.rationale: A comprehensive music school management system built on Laravel 12 and Filament PHP v3, chosen to get admin/instructor/student back-office UI without hand-building CRUD.

nodes.label: Hand-Written Controllers vs Filament REST Plugin
nodes.norm_label: hand-written controllers vs filament rest plugin
nodes.rationale: An explicit open trade-off: write standard Laravel API controllers from scratch (control, clean JSON contract) versus adopting a Filament REST API plugin (speed, coupling to panel resources). The decision was left to be argued with pros and cons for this stack.

nodes.label: Mobile Token Storage and Fetch Pattern
nodes.norm_label: mobile token storage and fetch pattern
nodes.rationale: The mobile frontend (React Native or Swift, left as a choice) must store the bearer token securely rather than in plain storage, and attach it to sample GET requests.

nodes.label: Stateless API vs Stateful Filament Constraint
nodes.norm_label: stateless api vs stateful filament constraint
nodes.rationale: Filament and Livewire rely on stateful session authentication, so the new mobile API must be stateless and its auth setup must coexist with the existing admin panel without breaking it — this is stated as the crucial constraint driving the whole design.

nodes.label: Dynamic Branch Pricing (Luxury Centers)
nodes.rationale: is_luxury_branch and markup_percentage on the Branch model let premium locations (e.g. 20% markup for Ajah) be priced by data rather than duplicated catalogs; the Advanced Diploma series is deliberately exempted because those programs are already priced at a premium and double-marking them would distort the catalog.

nodes.label: API/Filament Guard Separation
nodes.rationale: The token API is strictly separated from the web portal's session-based Filament guards, so adding mobile auth cannot break existing admin panel logins; deployments touching guards require optimize:clear.

nodes.label: Import Duplicate Resolution Cascade
nodes.rationale: Existing students are matched by student_number, then email, then the first_name + last_name + phone triple; matched rows are updated with the latest financial snapshot instead of erroring or creating duplicates, so repeated imports are idempotent.

nodes.label: Unlocked Lesson Progression
nodes.rationale: Lessons unlock progressively; the mobile courses endpoints must respect the same unlock logic as the web portal so the API cannot be used to skip ahead.

nodes.label: Multi-Panel Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separate Filament panels for Admins, Instructors, and Students keep role-specific surfaces and guards isolated rather than gating one shared panel by permission.

nodes.label: Production Deployment Procedure
nodes.rationale: composer install --optimize-autoloader --no-dev, migrate --force, then optimize:clear — the cache clear matters specifically because cached config/routes would otherwise serve stale auth guard definitions after API changes.

nodes.label: UserRoleSeeder Overhashing Fix
nodes.rationale: Hash::make() in the seeder combined with a model-level hashed cast double-hashed admin passwords, silently breaking default admin logins; the fix removes the explicit hash and relies on the cast alone.
